name: Nature Based Solutions for Pollution Control
description: Fundamentals of nature based treatment, sources and pathways of pollution, types of pollutants, pollutant characteristics, removal mechanisms, wastewater treatment techniques, pre-treatment, constructed wetlands, ponds, soil infiltration, design of treatment scheme, selection of treatment scheme, treatability, techno economic considerations, solutions for onsite and decentralized wastewater treatment, greywater treatment, removal of conventional and emerging pollutants, reuse of wastewater, suitability of wastewater for reuse, resource recovery, sludge treatment, rejuvenation of waterbodies, green infrastructure.
